title: AdicUnitTraceTensorCoordinates
statement: Let $D$ be a finite-field datum and $C$ its coefficient datum with prime $\ell\ne p$ and fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite inside this closure. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ between separated finite-type $D.k$-schemes, and let $S$ be the specified coefficient-compatible compact-support/exceptional adjunction system on the uniform finite-Tor constructible categories. For the completed Tate line and smooth pullback, define the shifted degree-zero line complex. Its canonical twist reassociation is degree-zero total-tensor collapse followed by the inverse second-slot shift comparison and Koszul symmetry. Define the ordered completed tensor functor and the restricted source functor. IsJNormalized specifies its localized formula on every K-flat representative using the recorded tensor models and ordinary-to-completed map. Normalize the coefficient-unit constraint by scalar multiplication, expressed by the total-complex left unitor on every K-flat representative. Uses [def-pur-unit-trace-reduction-data], [def-pur-adic-projection-trace-data], [def-pur-adic-scalar-trace-data], [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data], [def-pur-adic-purity-objects], [def-pur-adic-source-reduction], [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [def-pur-site-sheaf-tensor-presentation-data], [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data], [def-pur-finite-trace-presentation-data].
